name: John Cuturilo
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: John Cuturilo is Your Listener, based in Dandenong VIC, Australia. John is an empathic, approachable, and knowledgeable counsellor who provides services remotely across Australia, in his offices in Clayton and Beaconsfield Upper, and via home visit in his catchment area. He works with a broad range of clients and issues, with specialisations in trauma, relational matters, healthy habits, and men's and seniors' mental health.

name: Julia Goncalves Longo
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am a psychologist from Brazil with over 10 years of experience in forensic psychology, cognitive behavioral therapy, and clinical practice. I have worked with individuals facing legal issues, substance use, domestic violence, and mental health challenges. Additionally, I have experience supporting mothers, pregnant women, those trying to conceive, and individuals going through the adoption process.

name: Julie Wacker
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: “Julie is a warm, experienced and highly ethical counsellor who brings genuine care and humour to her work. She listens closely, knows when to bring lightness and when to simply hold space, helping clients feel safe, respected and genuinely understood.“
